description: This file defines a Tokenizer class used for tokenizing strings with customizable delimiters, supporting multi-character delimiters and trimming tokens.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A tokenizer that splits strings based on single or multi-character delimiters, with optional trimming of tokens.

methods.name: Tokenizer(List<String> delimiters)
methods.description: Constructs a Tokenizer with specified delimiters, optimizing for single-character delimiters.

methods.name: isTrimTokens()
methods.description: Checks if tokens are trimmed during tokenization.

methods.name: setTrimTokens(boolean trimTokens)
methods.description: Sets whether tokens should be trimmed.

methods.name: tokenize(String string)
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on the configured delimiters.
